blocks.prompt: 12 Solve the following trigonometric equation: \(\tan x = \sin 2x\)
blocks.explanation:
Dono sides ko \(\sin x\) aur \(\cos x\) mein likhenge. Lekin pehle ek shart note kar lein: \(\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\) sirf wahan defined hai jahan \(\cos x \ne 0\).
Fraction khatam karne ke baad \(\sin x\) common factor ban jata hai.
Find kya karna hai? Principal solutions aur general solution.
Plan: \(\sin x = 0\) aur \(\cos^{2}x = \frac{1}{2}\) hal karo, aakhir mein shart check karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan x = \sin 2x\).
Maloom karna: principal solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: \(\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\) aur \(\sin 2x = 2\sin x\cos x\) likhenge, \(\cos x\) se multiply karenge (jaaiz hai kyunke jahan \(\tan x\) mojood hai wahan \(\cos x \ne 0\)), phir factorise.

Sine aur cosine mein likhein
\[\dfrac{\sin x}{\cos x} = 2\sin x\cos x\]
Kyun: ab dono taraf ek hi angle \(x\) hai aur sirf do ratios hain. Jab tak angles alag hon (\(x\) aur \(2x\)), common factor nikalna mumkin nahin hota; isi liye double-angle formula sab se pehle lagaya.

Fraction khatam karein
\[\sin x = 2\sin x\cos^{2}x\]
\[\sin x - 2\sin x\cos^{2}x = 0\]
\[\sin x\left(1 - 2\cos^{2}x\right) = 0\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(\cos x\) se multiply kiya, phir sab ek taraf la kar \(\sin x\) common nikala.
Dhyan dein: \(\sin x = 2\sin x\cos^{2}x\) dekh kar \(\sin x\) cancel karne ka dil chahta hai; aisa kiya to \(0, \pi, 2\pi\) gum ho jayenge.

Do cases
\[\sin x = 0\ \text{ or }\ \cos^{2}x = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: product zero to koi ek factor zero; doosre factor se \(2\cos^{2}x = 1\).

Jab \(\sin x = 0\)
\[x = 0,\ \pi,\ 2\pi\]
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein; aam taur par \(x = n\pi\).
Kyun: sine (unit circle par y-coordinate) sirf x-axis wale do points par zero hota hai, jo aadhe chakkar ke faasle par hain; is liye \(\pi\) ke har multiple par zero. In points par \(\cos x = \pm 1\) hai, to \(\tan x\) bhi defined hai.

Jab \(\cos^{2}x = \frac{1}{2}\)
\[\cos x = \pm\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\).
\[\cos x = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}:\ x = \dfrac{\pi}{4},\ \dfrac{7\pi}{4}\]
\[\cos x = -\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}:\ x = \dfrac{3\pi}{4},\ \dfrac{5\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: square root ke saath \(\pm\); cosine positive ho to quadrant I, IV; negative ho to II, III. Har quadrant mein ek angle aaya.

Shart check karein
In mein se kisi angle par \(\cos x = 0\) nahin, is liye \(\tan x\) sab par defined hai aur koi root rad nahin hota.
Kyun: hum ne \(\cos x\) se multiply kiya tha; agar kisi root par \(\cos x = 0\) hota (jaise \(\frac{\pi}{2}\)), to woh asal equation mein mojood hi na hota aur use nikalna parta.

General solution
\[\left\{n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{3\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{5\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{7\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\},\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\]
Kyun: dono cases ki families ka union. Chaaron \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) wali families \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke faasle par hain, is liye inhein ek saath \(\frac{\pi}{4} + \frac{n\pi}{2}\) bhi likh sakte hain.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \dfrac{\pi}{4}:\ \tan\dfrac{\pi}{4} = 1,\ \sin\dfrac{\pi}{2} = 1\]
\[x = \dfrac{3\pi}{4}:\ \tan\dfrac{3\pi}{4} = -1,\ \sin\dfrac{3\pi}{2} = -1\]
Kyun: dono taraf barabar aaye. \(x = n\pi\) par \(\tan x = 0\) aur \(\sin 2x = \sin 2n\pi = 0\), woh bhi barabar.
blocks.final_answer: Principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein: \(x = 0, \frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{3\pi}{4}, \pi, \frac{5\pi}{4}, \frac{7\pi}{4}, 2\pi\). General solution: \(\left\{n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{3\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{5\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{7\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\). (Chhoti shakal: \(\{n\pi\} \cup \left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + \frac{n\pi}{2}\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Kitab ke examples ki tarah hum principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein aur general solution sets ke union ki shakal mein dete hain. Aap apna kaam yahan wale hal se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
